_readme: Per-business settings for the Missed-Call Text-Back template. Edits take effect on the next webhook call (no restart). Phone numbers here are fictional 555-01xx demo numbers.

llm.note: Optional. When true, the 'LLM Personalize' node (disabled by default) is used. It needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint + credential. Output falls back to the template on any problem.

defaults._quiet_hours_note: Local time window with no reminder/review texts. Missed-call text-backs ignore it (the caller just called).

router._note: Inbound-SMS router (/webhook/sms-in). Routes a reply to the automation that most recently texted this number.
router.help_template: {{business_name}}: texts about your calls, appointments and visits. Questions? Call {{business_number}}. Msg&data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.
